name: Arabian Gulf Shortbread Cookies  Ghiraybah
instructions: First of all , sifting is an important part which must not be left out or the cookies will not turn out the right texture so be sure you have a sieve
If need be , chill samneh or butter in refrigerator if too soft
Put samneh in mixing bowl and beat until light
Gradually add sifted icing sugar , beating until very creamy and light
Sift flour and fold into butter mixture
If kitchen is hot , chill dough in refrigerator for 1-2 hours
Roll pieces of dough into balls the size of a walnut and place on ungreased baking sheets
Top half or all with a slivered almond
Bake in the preheated moderately slow oven for 20-25 minutes until very lightly coloured
Dust the other half without the almond slivers with icing sugar
These are very delicate biscuits and must be handled carefully
